consequence.statement: Existing Services without a protocol set are preserved unchanged after the upgrade to avoid connection disruptions, and their protocol is not taken into account by the agent until they are deleted and recreated.
consequence.remediation: Delete and recreate any Service that was without a protocol set so the agent takes its protocol into account; note that a later downgrade to a version without services protocol differentiation will cause services with a protocol set to be deleted and recreated without the protocol, disrupting connections for those services.

assertion.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 adds services protocol differentiation, enabled by default and controllable with the cilium-agent flag --bpf-lb-proto-diff; after the upgrade, existing Services without a protocol set are preserved as such and must be deleted and recreated for their protocol to be taken into account by the agent.
